name: Clarence Thomas
role: Associate Justice of the U.S. Supreme Court (1991-present); chairman of the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (1982-1990)
summary: A natural-rights originalist who reads the Constitution through the Declaration of Independence: government exists to secure God-given individual rights, power should be divided and limited, and the law should be colorblind. He opposes racial preferences, disparate-impact liability, broad federal power under the Commerce Clause and delegation of lawmaking, supports gun rights, school choice, religious exemptions and presidential control of the executive branch, and distrusts expert and administrative rule.
